name: w-annotator-launch-video
description: Remotion project that composes the W Annotator launch video from recorded app footage.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Launch out/launch-full.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/launch-full.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an ../docs/assets/launch.mp4
